Senior Quantitative Analyst - Global Finance





At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Quantitative Analyst at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in cloud computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


This position offers a unique opportunity to be a part of the modeling and quantitative analytics team in the dynamic Capital Markets & Analytics (CMA) organization at Capital One. The CMA organization has been on a technology journey seeking to find ways to leverage technology to drive deeper market insights, manage financial risks and make the complex simple.  We are looking for candidates to help in our journey with modeling, analytical and model implementation skills.


Responsibilities and Skills:

- Partner with the various lines of business to develop and enhance Capital Markets modeling and analytical framework, such as  derivatives models and fixed income models.

- Work across Capital One entities to create novel analytical solutions to challenging business problems.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods and automation solutions to improve business performance and process efficiencies.

- Collaborate in a cross-disciplinary team to build cloud-based solutions grounded in data.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods or machine learning to improve business performance.

- Apply deep expertise in mathematics, statistical and machine learning methods to generate critical insights and decision frameworks for our business and customers.

- Providing technical guidance to business leadership.

- Communicate technical subject matter clearly and concisely to individuals from various backgrounds.

- Understand and navigate Risk Management Software to enable business analysis.
 

Expertise in quantitative analysis is central to our success in all markets. Our modelers thrive in a culture of mutual respect, excellence and innovation. 


Successful candidates would possess: 

- Deep understanding of quantitative modeling in relation to finance, capital markets, derivatives and investment portfolio modeling principles.

- Extensive experience in Python or other object-oriented language.

- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to a wide range of audiences.

- Drive to develop and maintain high quality and transparent model documentation. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation skills. 

- Ability to fully own the model development process: from conceptualization through data exploration, model selection, validation, deployment, business user training, and monitoring.
 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an exception that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 1 year of experience in quantitative analyticsAt least 1 year of experience in each of the following skills through education or experience:Statistical or econometric modelingLinear and logistic regressionProgramming in R, Python or SQLPresenting statistical concepts and research results to non-statistical audienceAt least 1 year of experience in at least 3 of the following skills:Survival analysis modelingTime-series analysisPanel data (longitudinal data or cross-sectional time-series data) analysisCross-sectional data analysisMachine learningAnalysis and management of large datasets (>1M records)

2 years of experience with Python, R or other statistical analyst software

jobs_results.description:
About Our Company

Working at Columbia Threadneedle Investments you'll find growth and career opportunities across all of our businesses.

We're intentionally built to help you succeed. Our reach is expansive with a Columbia Threadneedle Investments global team of 2,300 people working together. Our capability is diverse with more than 550 investment professionals sharing global perspectives across all major asset classes and markets. Our clients have access to a broad array of investment strategies, and we have the capability to create bespoke solutions matched to clients' specific requirements. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our enterprise businesses — Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities.

Job Description

Columbia Threadneedle Investments is a global investment firm with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Our Quantitative Equity Research team is looking for a curious, driven Quantitative Analyst to join us. We build and maintain a suite of stock selection models that power both systematic and fundamental strategies throughout the firm. In this role, you will research new signals, develop alpha models, and refine our portfolio construction methods. You will also play a hands-on part in shaping the research and analytics platforms we rely on every day and share ownership of the models we run in production. Working closely with fundamental analysts and portfolio managers across the globe, you will exchange ideas and insights while broadening your expertise across a wide range of investment approaches. If you enjoy solving investment problems with data and want to grow alongside a collaborative team, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Research and Model Development

Contribute to research projects spanning idea generation, data preparation, statistical analysis, and actionable recommendations

Evaluate innovative techniques for extracting tradable signals from large datasets

Develop alpha models and refine portfolio construction methodologies

Production and Monitoring

Share ownership of implementing and maintaining the team's models in production

Enhance the team's research infrastructure and analytics platforms

Monitor and analyze factor and model performance, and conduct due diligence on model output

Communication and Collaboration

Collaborate with portfolio managers and fundamental analysts across the firm, exchanging ideas, sharing regular performance insights, and responding to their inquiries

Present research findings to key stakeholders and develop thought leadership content

Qualifications

Experience and Technical Skills

Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field

Minimum 3 years of direct experience in quantitative investment research, including hands-on development and testing of stock selection signals or alpha models

Solid grasp of equity markets, factor investing, and portfolio construction, coupled with strong intellectual curiosity

Deep knowledge of statistical modeling, econometric analysis, and machine learning, with demonstrated ability to apply these techniques to investment problems

Strong programming proficiency in Python, R, or similar languages, including experience working with large financial datasets

Advanced problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with the ability to frame research questions, challenge assumptions, and separate robust signals from noise

Professional Attributes

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both quantitative and fundamental audiences

Self-directed, with a track record of owning research projects from initial idea through production

High standards of professionalism and reliability, with keen attention to detail and consistent delivery of accurate work on schedule

Collaborative working style and strong interest in building a long-term career in quantitative investing

CFA charterholder or candidate preferred

Visa Sponsorship

Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN

In-Office Collaboration

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $140,000- $160,000 / year. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances.

Principal Quantitative Analyst - Model Risk Office





At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Quantitative Analyst at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in cloud computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


As a Quantitative Analyst within the Model Risk Office, you will be part of the validation team responsible for balance sheet forecasting and economic stress test models used to determine capital requirements for Capital One's balance sheet items, including commercial and consumer loans.  Validations cover all aspects of model development and performance and include forward-looking advancements in modeling capabilities and quality. With a network of over 500 quantitative analysts, data scientists and statisticians, we’ve created a dynamic environment with ample opportunities for learning and growth. 


Responsibilities and Skills:

- Partner with the various lines of business to develop and enhance Capital Markets modeling and analytical framework, such as deposit predictions, derivatives models and fixed income models.

- Work across Capital One entities to create novel analytical solutions to challenging business problems.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods and automation solutions to improve business performance and process efficiencies.

- Collaborate in a cross-disciplinary team to build cloud-based solutions grounded in data.

- Identify opportunities to apply quantitative methods or machine learning to improve business performance.

- Apply deep expertise in mathematics, statistical and machine learning methods to generate critical insights and decision frameworks for our business and customers.

- Providing technical guidance to business leadership.

- Communicate technical subject matter clearly and concisely to individuals from various backgrounds.

- Understand and navigate Risk Management Software to enable business analysis.
  

Expertise in quantitative analysis is central to our success in all markets. Our modelers thrive in a culture of mutual respect, excellence and innovation. 


Successful candidates would possess: 

- Deep understanding of quantitative modeling in finance include but not limited to, financial time series model, interest rate term structure, Mortgage Prepayment Model,  Market Risk Model, capital markets and investment portfolio modeling principles.

- Extensive experience in Python or other object-oriented languages such as C++.

- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to a wide range of audiences.

- Drive to develop and maintain high quality and transparent model documentation. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation skills. 

- Ability to fully own the model validation process: from conceptualization through data exploration, model selection, benchmarking, deployment, replication, independent testing, effective challenging, and performance monitoring. jobs_results.description:
The City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System (COAERS) mission is to provide our members with their promised benefits. We are driven to be best-in-class, passionate about service excellence, and committed to creating a welcoming environment where everyone can excel by leveraging our skillset, experiences, and backgrounds.




Your Opportunity 

Reporting to the Deputy Chief Investment Officer, the Quantitative Analyst is responsible for applying analytical techniques, financial modeling, and data science methodologies to support COAERS objectives and strategic decision-making. This role combines data analysis, research, forecasting, and risk assessment to evaluate performance, identify trends, and support optimization initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, leadership, and external partners to provide insights, develop models, and facilitate data-driven recommendations that enhance operational and investment outcomes.




Your Main Responsibilities




Investment Data Analysis 

• Analyze large and complex financial datasets, including market, economic, fundamental, and alternative data sources.

• Conduct statistical analysis of historical information including market performance and investment strategies.

• Perform factor analysis and predictive modeling to evaluate investment hypotheses.

• Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that communicate key investment insights and recommendations.

• Utilize analytical tools to automate data collection, analysis, and reporting processes.




Risk Management

• Measure portfolio risks using quantitative metrics such as volatility, Value-at-Risk (VaR), tracking error, beta, drawdown, and stress-testing methodologies.

• Evaluate the risk-versus-reward profile of existing and proposed investments.

• Develop risk models and scenario analyses to assess portfolio resilience under varying market conditions.

• Collaborate on portfolio adjustments to improve risk-adjusted returns and align with investment objectives.

• Monitor compliance with risk limits and investment guidelines.




Portfolio Analytics and Research

• Support portfolio construction and optimization through quantitative research and modeling.

• Conduct performance attribution analysis to identify drivers of investment returns.

• Identify portfolio concentrations, correlations, and other exposures that may impact portfolio performance.

• Research emerging quantitative techniques, investment factors, and market developments.

• Evaluate new data sources and analytical tools that may enhance investment decision-making.




Operational Data Management and Insights

• Design, build, and maintain centralized databases and data warehouses by integrating business applications, cloud platforms, internal databases, and third-party software to support organizational reporting, analytics, and decision-making.

• Develop data architecture that integrates information from multiple internal and external systems.

• Perform advanced data analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. 

• Develop dashboards, reports, and interactive visualizations for management and executive leadership.

• Translate complex data and collaborate with leadership on action items. 

• Establish procedures for data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance.

• Establish standards for data collection, storage, security, and governance.

• Develop, extract, transform, and load processes to consolidate data from disparate systems.

• Monitor and troubleshoot data synchronization and integration issues.

• Create key performance indicators (KPIs) and performance measurement frameworks.

• Develop documentation for databases, data processes, and reporting systems.

• Perform work as assigned with executive leadership. 




Your Capabilities and Credentials

• Work with large datasets for the purpose of data analysis and interpretation. 

• Conduct research into data analytics and reporting.

• Knowledge of statistical analysis, quantitative methods, data modeling, and data visualization techniques.

• Ability to use analytical tools and software to evaluate data, identify trends, assess risk, and provide data-driven recommendations that support business decision-making.

• Effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

• Well organized, with keen attention to detail.

• Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including an ability to communicate in both technical and non-technical language.

• Contribute to positive work relationships in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.




Education and/or Experience 

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, or a related quantitative field. At least three years of experience in investment analysis, quantitative research, asset management, or a related field. Knowledge of financial markets, securities, portfolio theory, and investment risk management. Advanced analytical, statistical, and forecasting modeling capabilities. Proficiency with Python, Excel, SQL, MATLAB, or similar quantitative analysis tools. Experience working with large datasets and financial databases. 




Preferred Qualifications

Experience in pension funds, endowments, other institutional LP or public sector environments. Advanced degree in statistics, data analytics, or similar.




Certificates, Licenses, Registrations 

Valid Texas driver’s license or available alternate means of transportation. Relevant certifications in data and/or quantitative analysis. Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) and/or Chartered Alternative Investments Analyst (CAIA) designation, or progress toward obtaining such designation, is preferred.




Travel

May require limited travel for training or conferences, as required.




Compensation and Benefits

The starting salary will be between $110,000 to $125,000 annually with the actual compensation corresponding to the experience level and credentials of the candidate within the parameters of public sector compensation. An excellent benefits package is available, including medical, dental, vision, sick and vacation leave as well as a defined benefit retirement plan, which guarantees an income for life once vested. Parking is provided.




Work Location

COAERS offers a hybrid work schedule, meaning this position will work in an office environment with opportunities to work remotely. During the initial training period (usually 3 months), the work location is in-person Monday through Friday at 4700 Mueller Blvd, Austin TX. After the training period is successfully completed, work is hybrid with three days in-person at 4700 Mueller Blvd, Austin TX and two days per week remote. Work location is subject to change at the supervisor's discretion. 




COAERS is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of any characteristic protected by federal law. We are committed to a recruitment process that is accessible. If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

jobs_results.description:
About Base




Base is America's next-generation power company. We're rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization-electricity-by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today's fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.



About the Role

About the Role




Quant Analysts build and improve the models that drive Base's Trading & Risk platform - the system that spans our distributed fleet of batteries and the households we serve. You'll own the price models that tell Base where value exists in wholesale markets like ERCOT and PJM, and the hedging strategy that turns that analysis into a plan for managing Base's risk.




This is a mid-to-senior role that combines quantitative analysis, software engineering, and energy market expertise. Base has a price model for ERCOT that provides the foundation for future improvements. You'll extend that work to PJM, sharpen how Base captures grid congestion, and use what you build to shape Base's hedging strategy there.



What You'll Do



 Improve Base's price distributions by capturing grid congestion effects, like midday price excursions regularly seen, that our current models miss
 Build a price model for PJM, so Base can track risk and make hedging decisions there as well as it already does in ERCOT
 Build a hedging strategy for PJM, using the models you build to decide what that strategy should be




What You'll Bring



 Energy markets and domain knowledge: you understand wholesale energy market operations like ERCOT, including real-time arbitrage, ancillary services, and capacity, along with unit commitment, economic dispatch, and production cost modeling
 Coding and SQL: you build models in Python (or another language) and pull your own data with SQL, and you can work through a model independently
 Statistics and machine learning: You understand the bias-variance tradeoff, train/validation/test evaluation, and loss functions for categorical and continuous targets, and you're deeply familiar with at least one statistical subfield, like extreme value theory, information theory, or stochastic processes. You've deployed models to production with versioning and maintenance, scaled training beyond a single machine, and know Python, pandas, and visualization libraries well.




About the Team




Base's Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team's calls carry real weight - a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base's book. You'll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.




Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.



Our Values



 First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.
 Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.
 Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.
 Everyone's an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.
 Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.
 Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we're creating. We work in-person. It's not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.
 Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
Do the best work of your life at Base.
